name: Alma’s Disk – Atom
summary:
"Alma's Disk" is an immersive VR learning experience that explores the composition and structure of Bohr's atomic model. Players can move freely within the inside of an atom, similar to a "sandbox world," and use various tools such as magnets, magnifying glasses, scales, and calculators to investigate the different elementary particles of the atom, along with their properties and structure.
